annotations.title: Plan upgrades across a shared collection

description: Plan upgrades for 2–3 Commander decks in priority order with a shared inventory and USD purchase budget. Returns allocation, proposed swaps, and an optional cart. Supports fresh inputs, a portable backup, or restoration by private plan ID.

deck.description: Quantity-prefixed main-deck text including the commander. Import public deck URLs with import_deck first, then pass the returned text.

owned.description: Total collection inventory, including copies used by all submitted decks. Up to 150 quantity-prefixed entries and 100 copies per canonical card.

qaTest.description: Internal QA only: set true when the user explicitly says this is our test run. Excludes the call from usage/revenue statistics. Omit for normal player requests.

searchContext.description: Optional opaque context from a preceding card search for attributing a related request.
